title: Favorite Series on GurneyJourney
content: This week the GurneyJourney blog passes 2,000 posts. For nearly the last five years, I've been doing a new blog post every day.To commemorate the occasion, I’d like to present you with some of the most popular series of posts. These are big topics that I couldn't cover in a single day. Even if you're a regular visitor, maybe some of these will be new to you.Water Reflections SeriesWater Reflections, Part 1Water Reflections, Part 2Water Reflections, Part 3Color Wheel SeriesPart 1:
